sections.label: Profile
sections.text: Hi! My name is Eduardo Fuentes, a Software Engineer with over 5 years of experience designing and developing backend applications for mission-critical systems, working on platform modernization, migration, and integration projects in high-availability environments.

sections.label: Stack
sections.text: My main focus is backend development with Java (Spring Boot) and Node.js (Express and NestJS), applying principles such as SOLID, Clean Architecture, domain-driven design, and solid testing practices to build maintainable and scalable software. Although my specialty is backend, I also have experience building interfaces with React, which lets me collaborate across the full stack and communicate effectively with frontend teams.

sections.label: Achievements
sections.text: The most relevant milestones of my career — the decoupled-architecture migration of a critical ChileCompra service, Fast Checkout for Ripley, and the query optimization that cut response times — are detailed role-by-role in the Experience section.

sections.label: Goal
sections.text: In my free time I explore new tools and frameworks, and I also create content about technology. My goal is to keep growing into roles where I can contribute not only by writing code but also by designing scalable systems, making architecture decisions, and building products with real impact. If you're interested in collaborating or just want to talk about technology, feel free to reach out.

jobs.title: Web Developer
description: Maintained and extended the SENCE institutional web platform in .NET, adding new features without disrupting production.

jobs.title: Programming Analyst
description: Developed and supported backend services for corporate clients using PHP (CodeIgniter, WordPress), Java, and Go.
Improved integration between systems, streamlining communication across internal and external services.
Configured and administered Linux environments and VPNs, ensuring security and operational continuity.
Coordinated maintenance windows and production deployments, ensuring service continuity.

jobs.title: Backend Developer | Public Market
description: Built and maintained REST microservices with Java 8 and Spring Boot for Public Market.
Applied design patterns (DAO, DTO, Dependency Injection) that improved code modularity and maintainability.
Raised code quality and system stability working under GitFlow and Scrum.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Public Market | Factory | Ripley
description: Led the migration of a critical ChileCompra service (Consultas al Mercado) to a decoupled architecture, increasing its availability and resilience in production.
Contributed to Fast Checkout for Ripley, designing backend microservices with Node.js (Express, NestJS) and Java (Spring Boot).
Optimized queries and indexes in PostgreSQL and MongoDB, significantly reducing response times for critical processes.
Implemented automated testing (Jest, JUnit) under TDD and applied SOLID/Clean Architecture on Innovación-Fábrica (end-to-end testing system) and Registro de Proveedores.
Worked with distributed systems communicating via Kafka, decoupling processing between services.
Developed full-stack features and maintenance with React, Spring Boot, and SQL Server.

jobs.title: Software Engineer | Public Market
description: Develop and maintain backend microservices in a high-criticality production environment for Public Market / ChileCompra, with Spring Boot.
Synchronize transactional databases with replicas on Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL, ensuring consistency and performance.
Review and optimize serverless functions on AWS, resolving critical incidents and improving technical standards and documentation.
Work with distributed systems communicating via Kafka to decouple processing between services.
Develop full-stack features and maintenance with React, Spring Boot, and SQL Server.

featured.title: FinanceHub — From no-code to production
featured.description: Full migration of a personal finance platform from a no-code tool (Base44) to an in-house stack, following a spec-driven development discipline: API contract and database schema fixed before writing code, with every task verified against a real running system (never just green tests). Deployed to production on Cloud Run with real CI/CD via GitHub Actions.
